title: AccessGranted v1
description: Emitted when a user becomes the owner of a business (created by an admin) or is added as staff by the owner. inviteId is set when the account has no password (newly created, or created earlier and never activated); the worker then generates the invite token and sends a set-password email. Otherwise the worker sends a notice that the user now has the role.

inviteId.description: The user_invites row to send (a new row for this grant), or null when the user already has a password.
